lines.en: I cross the ridge, heavy on my claws.
My tail sweeps the ground.
This black armor is heavy.
My frame weighs a great deal.
I go from the ridges into the dark wood.

lines.zh: 我的每一步都让碎石滑。
lines.en: Every step sends scree sliding.

lines.zh: 我垂着头，肩甲擦过树梢。
lines.en: Head low, my shoulder plates brush the treetops.
I prowl near my anchor point.
My shoulder plating rings.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，树都弯了。
lines.en: The trees bend where I pass.

lines.zh: 我掉转身体，甲片一片片响。
lines.en: I turn, plate rasping against plate.
I do not run. I bear down.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了看坡上的树线。
lines.en: I glance up at the treeline on the slope.

lines.zh: 每走一步，趾尖都陷进土。
lines.en: With every step my toes sink into the soil.
I stand, my chest generating heat.

lines.zh: 没有命令，我就一直站着。
lines.en: Without an order, I simply stand.
My arms hang.
Poison gathers in my throat.
A few stones slide down the slope.

lines.zh: 我半阖着眼，听山里的动静。
lines.en: Eyes half shut, I listen to the mountain.
I am thinking nothing.
The mountain wind strikes my armor.
There are old scars on my leg.
I am listening to the distance.

lines.zh: 这具身体，是训练出来的。
lines.en: This body was trained into being.

lines.zh: 我伏在岩上，听风换方向。
lines.en: I lie on the rock, listening to the wind turn.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，嗅了嗅上风处。
lines.en: I raise my head and sniff upwind.
My breathing is low.
You stand below my slope.

lines.zh: 我认得训练过我的那种眼神。
lines.en: I know the look of one who trains.
Are you the master?
I am twice your height.

lines.zh: 我俯下身，把你看了个清楚。
lines.en: I lean down and take all of you in.

lines.zh: 退到坡下，我才能看清你。
lines.en: Step down the slope so I can see you clearly.
I was made for fighting.

lines.zh: 手放在我看得见的地方。
lines.en: Keep your hands where I can see them.

lines.zh: 你是敌是友，我还在掂量。
lines.en: Friend or foe, I am still weighing it.
Give your name first.
My teeth are long.
One step back will do.
We need distance between us.
I am listening.

lines.zh: 站住别动，让我看清你的脸。
lines.en: Stand still and let me see your face.
I do not like being circled behind.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，甲响了一声。
lines.en: I step back and my armor rings.

lines.zh: 甲裂了，里面的线露出来。
lines.en: The plate splits; the wiring inside shows.
A growl rolls up out of my chest.
My chest is still humming.

lines.zh: 甲上凹了一块，我照样站。
lines.en: A plate is dented; I stand all the same.
I shifted my weight.
Blood seeps from a seam.

lines.zh: 我用前爪撑地，把身子挺直。
lines.en: I push off my foreclaws and straighten up.

lines.zh: 血在甲缝里淌，我不当回事。
lines.en: Blood trickles between my plates; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 打得好，再来，我看你能几下。
lines.en: Good hit. Again; let us see how many you have.
Is that a digital fish?

lines.zh: 这玩意儿连牙缝都塞不满。
lines.en: This thing would not fill a gap in my teeth.
Only meat goes down.
Set it on the ground; do not raise it to my face.
One gulp and it is gone; too light.
I only sniff; I do not lick.
This piece is not enough.

lines.zh: 还有吗，我舌头都没尝到。
lines.en: Any more? My tongue did not even taste it.
Then I accept it.
Remember this time.

lines.zh: 你的气味我记下了，收起来吧。
lines.en: I have your scent now. Put it away.
I do not snatch.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞上我的小腿骨。
lines.en: You crash your whole body into my shin bone.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我连爪尖都没挪。
lines.en: You crash into me; even my claw tips do not shift.
My armor shed the force.
You stumble back over loose stones.

lines.zh: 再近，我的尾巴会扫到你。
lines.en: Closer, and my tail will sweep you off your feet.

lines.zh: 我把肩甲偏开，让你过去。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder plate aside and let you pass.
The earth beside my foot shakes.
My foot is thicker than your waist.
Steady yourself.
Move along now.
I stay up on the slope and do not come near.
That is not something I know.
Another shadow is beyond the hill.

lines.zh: 我们只用爪子在地上划。
lines.en: We only scrape marks into the dirt.
It also prowls near an anchor.

lines.zh: 隔着山脊，我们对视了一瞬。
lines.en: Across the ridge, we lock eyes for an instant.
Then each went its own way.
The mountain wind is cold.

lines.zh: 整座山只有我们的呼吸。
lines.en: The whole mountain holds only our breathing.
That is how it is.
There is iron on the ground.

lines.zh: 两根手指就把它夹了起来。
lines.en: Two fingers are enough to pinch it up.
Too small for my grip.
I tuck it into a gap in my armor.
Iron? I will keep it to shim my armor seams.
Too light; I set it back on the stone.

lines.zh: 这铁牌上刻着别人的记号。
lines.en: Someone's mark is cut into this iron tag.
I toss it aside.
Useless; I toss it into the gully.
Once I have it, I turn and leave.

lines.zh: 你被我的视线钉在原地。
lines.en: My gaze pins you where you stand.
You moved.
My throat has heated up.

lines.zh: 我把前爪扎进土里，蓄力。
lines.en: I dig my foreclaws into the soil and gather force.

lines.zh: 这一击我从山脊就开始蓄。
lines.en: I have been charging this since the ridge.

lines.zh: 跑也可以，我比你熟这山。
lines.en: Run if you like; I know this mountain better.
I am faster and heavier.

lines.zh: 我数到一，你就没机会了。
lines.en: I count to one, and your chance is gone.
I stop counting. Begin.
Do not wait; my claws arrive first.
Running will not help.
This pass is mine; take the long way.

lines.zh: 碎石在我爪下往两边滑。
lines.en: Gravel slides aside under my claws.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟已经碰到坡沿。
lines.en: Your heel has found the edge of the slope.

lines.zh: 你身后那排树，挡不住我。
lines.en: That row of trees behind you will not stop me.
My chest is humming.

lines.zh: 我把下巴抬起，露出喉咙里的毒。
lines.en: I lift my chin, baring the poison in my throat.
Poison in my mouth.
You run around the trees, but the trees are shorter.
Not as fast as I.

lines.zh: 我踩碎灌木，从侧翼逼近。
lines.en: I crush the brush and close in from the flank.

lines.zh: 毒在喉里滚了一圈，够了。
lines.en: The poison rolls once in my throat; enough.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，毒雾先探出来。
lines.en: I open my jaws; the poison mist leads the way.
I breathe the poison out.

lines.zh: 爪子落下，把地面砸出坑。
lines.en: My claw falls and craters the ground.

lines.zh: 我的前爪按住了你的肩。
lines.en: My foreclaw pins your shoulder down.
My claw marks go deep.
The poison breath goes out.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的胸甲砸凹。
lines.en: This blow dents your chestplate.

lines.zh: 你的盾架得稳，只撑了一下。
lines.en: Your shield held steady, for exactly one blow.
I add another swipe.
Blood on the soil.

lines.zh: 一击之后，我退半步再压上。
lines.en: After one blow I step back, then press in again.
Hot breath hisses out between my teeth.
Get up.

lines.zh: 打完这一击，我原地不动。
lines.en: After this blow, I do not move.
I come down off the ridge.
These highlands suit me.
First I take my footing.
Stones crack under me.
My armor catches the light.

lines.zh: 落地之后，我先转了一圈。
lines.en: Once down, I turn a full circle first.
Something moves beyond the ridge.

lines.zh: 我闻到了数码兽的味道。
lines.en: I smell another Digimon.
I have no master.
I hold still for now.

lines.zh: 第一步就把脚下的石板踩裂。
lines.en: My first step cracks the stone beneath it.
This is open enough.
Who will be the first?

lines.zh: 我把头扬起，朝山谷吼了一声。
lines.en: I rear my head and roar into the valley.
Fire heats my armor red.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下，我的腿先着地。
lines.en: I land on my legs from that height.
Water in my seams. Heavy.
The blast pushed me back half a step.
Something is lodged in my armor.

lines.zh: 咒力锁住关节，我挣了一下。
lines.en: Magic locks my joints; I wrench them free.
Without meat I cannot keep going.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，甲都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and my armor shone.

lines.zh: 脚下空着，我的爪抓不到东西。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; my claws find no hold.
